title: VIDEO_OUT
description: Output contract of Video Engine (11_VIDEO_ENGINE.md). Consumed by Render Engine.

camera_config.description: Input-side config carried alongside HOUSE_OUT into this engine (from 04_WORKFLOW.md Workflow_Step_House_to_Video_Payload).

x-error-codes.ERR_VID_01: Primary provider timeout (>120s) or 5xx -- blacklist temporarily, reroute to Luma or Runway
x-error-codes.ERR_VID_02: Excessive stutter/artifacts -- retry once, else substitute generic nature/scenery B-roll from Library

x-hard-rules: Zero text/branding/phone numbers may ever be drawn into the video (Absolute Media Neutrality).
Always cache output organized by style + camera-motion-direction.
Specify aspect ratio before generation to avoid later cropping.
Never burn in text -- price/contact changes must never trigger a video regeneration.
